WiFi Time Control won\'t be able to pause them, but it can show you the devices and notify you when a specific one or an unknown new one connects. Recording the panel is useful for that.
Nobody has checked it with the app yet. If you do, you\'ll help everyone: if you find the block option, record it; if not, tap «I can\'t find it» and report it.

(Catalog data is in the language of whoever contributed it.)

There's no sheet for this router yet: you'll be the first.

Before recording, spend 5 minutes looking for the block option in its panel. It's usually called:
• Parental control
• Access control
• MAC filter / MAC filtering
• Block device

⚠ These don't work and may cut everyone off: turning WiFi off (Disable), changing the router mode, or port tables, bridging or VLAN.

If you can't find it, tap «I can't find it» during recording: it will still be saved and you can report it to the catalog so nobody else wastes their time.

Your router's panel will open inside the app and I'll guide you through 5 steps: log in, see the devices, cut Internet to one, give it back and log out.

The app records what the panel does so its recipe can be written. The password and WiFi keys are removed from the recording. Nothing is sent anywhere until you decide to share it.

Do it while connected to that router's WiFi, and don't cut Internet to your own phone.

The AI will have replied with a block of text starting with { : that\'s the recipe. Copy all of it (the block\'s «Copy» button, or long-press → Copy) and tap «Paste».\n\nIf it gave you a .json file, you can open it with «Open file».

I've copied the recipe. GitHub will open with the «Nueva receta» (new recipe) form ready (title and test report):

1. Sign in to GitHub (or create a free account at github.com).
2. Long-press the «Receta» box and choose Paste.
3. Tick the confirmation box and tap «Create» (or «Submit new issue»).

In a couple of minutes you'll see on that same page whether the recipe is valid. Once approved, it will appear in the catalog for every user with a %1$s.
Go to: %1$s. Cut Internet to a device other than your phone and save.
In the same place (%1$s), give it back Internet and save.
The panel says it can only be done from the provider\'s app

Log out of the panel and tap Finish. The recording will let the app show this router\'s devices (without pausing them).\n\nWhen you finish you can report it to the catalog so nobody else tries with this model.

%1$d entries in «%2$s». The router password and WiFi keys have been removed.

Next steps:
1. Tap «Share with an AI» and choose Claude, ChatGPT or Gemini. The file already includes the instructions; if it asks for a message, write: «Read the instructions in the file and make me the recipe».
2. The AI will reply with a block of text starting with { : copy all of it (the block's «Copy» button).
3. In WiFi Time Control: Settings → Router model → My router is not listed → Import a recipe → Paste.

You can also save the file on your phone to do it later (receta-%3$s).
That way, anyone with a %1$s will know before starting that its panel can\'t block devices. GitHub will open with everything filled in: you just need to send it.

At the set time, this phone logs into the router and cuts or restores Internet for the devices in the schedule. For that, the phone must be connected to this location\'s WiFi; if it isn\'t, it retries every 5 minutes until the next change.\n\nIf you cut or restore Internet by hand in between, that is kept until the next change.

string-array.name: welcome_titles
string-array.item: Welcome to WiFi Time Control
Pause Internet for whoever you want
Automatic schedules
Know who connects
Works with your router
Everything stays on your phone

string-array.name: welcome_texts
string-array.item: Control from your phone which home devices have Internet, without turning WiFi off for everyone.
Pick the console, the tablet or the laptop and cut their Internet with one button. Another one brings it back.
«Monday to Friday, 21:00 to 8:00, no Internet»: the app does it by itself every day.
It alerts you when a specific device connects, or a new one you don\'t know.
It talks directly to your router. If yours isn\'t supported yet, you can teach it in a few minutes.
Passwords are stored encrypted on this phone. Nothing goes through anyone\'s servers.

string-array.name: learn_steps
string-array.item: Log in to the router panel
Open the list of connected devices
Cut Internet to a device
Give it back Internet
Log out of the panel

string-array.name: learn_help
string-array.item: Enter the router username and password as usual and log in.
Find the page that shows connected devices. It\'s usually called Local network, Clients, Devices or DHCP.
Pick a device that won\'t be missed and cut its Internet: look for Parental control, Access control, Block or MAC filter, and save.
Undo the previous step to give it back Internet, and save.
Tap Log out or Exit in the panel. Then tap Finish.

string-array.name: guide_titles
string-array.item: Router not listed?
Check its sheet
Record its panel
Give it to an AI
Test it
Share it

string-array.name: guide_texts
string-array.item: Add it yourself in about 15 minutes and share it with everyone.
Enter the brand and model from the sticker. The app tells you whether it can block and where.
Follow the 5 steps in the top bar. Your passwords are removed automatically.
Share it with Claude, ChatGPT or Gemini. It will give you the recipe.
Import it: the app reads and cuts Internet for a few seconds to check it.
Publish it and anyone with the same router will have it.
